blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu Province — A furry family member had its own share of the Kalag-Kalag tradition and was caught eating the halad or food offering prepared for departed loved ones in Lanao del Norte, Mindanao. In a TikTok video shared by Anna Leah Calumpang or Miss Anne during the observance of kalag-kalag on November 1, her pet cat, Puti, was seen nibbling on the food offering, turning a family tradition into its own feast.
